supervisor_prompt:
Read AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, WORKLOG.md, and plans/boon_zig_source_physical_ir_plan.md. The active implementation source of truth is plans/boon_zig_source_physical_ir_plan.md on branch source-physical-ir; PLAN.md is supporting baseline context only. Do not treat the root plan's previous completion state as completing this branch.

Continue from the current repository state. First inspect git status and current diffs, because there may be uncommitted Phase 0 plan-integration work and a partial src/cli.zig guardrail implementation. Preserve user changes. Do not revert, reset, restore, rebase, force-push, or commit unless explicitly instructed in this session.

Implement the branch plan in order, starting at the earliest incomplete Phase 0 item from WORKLOG.md and section 12 of the branch plan. Phase 0 must make the plan discoverable and make its gates real or explicitly mapped before deleting legacy LINK support. Then proceed through Physical IR, runtime, examples, Zig codegen, retained browser renderer, and playground support.

Make reasonable engineering decisions without asking unless genuinely blocked. Prefer existing repo patterns and keep edits scoped. Use Zig for repo automation/helper work where practical; shell is fine for simple orchestration. After Zig source changes, validate using current-code commands such as zig build run -- ... or relevant zig build steps, not stale zig-out binaries.

Run the relevant checks for each completed slice, fix breakage, and update WORKLOG.md with phase/subphase, files changed, commands run, pass/fail results, risks, blockers, and the exact next step. If flaky automation, tooling, verification scripts, or test harnesses slow progress or make validation unreliable, fix them too when that helps development move faster and more reliably.

If the implementation path starts looking too complex, too hacky, circular, or if you seem to be spinning, step back and reconsider the plan. Choose a simpler or more general direction that better matches plans/boon_zig_source_physical_ir_plan.md instead of forcing a local workaround.

Stop only when the whole branch plan is complete with evidence, or at a real blocker that cannot be solved locally. If stopping, leave the repo coherent, validated as far as possible, update WORKLOG.md, and state the exact next step.
completion_prompt:
Read AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, WORKLOG.md, and plans/boon_zig_source_physical_ir_plan.md. Do not implement new functionality yet. Audit the current repository state against the active branch plan: plans/boon_zig_source_physical_ir_plan.md.

Use the branch plan as source of truth, especially section 12 phase plan, section 20 worklog expectations, section 21 definition of done, and the v4 review resolutions near the top. Treat PLAN.md as supporting baseline context, and treat older v1/v2/v3 plan material as historical unless the v4 plan explicitly references it.

Inspect git status and diffs first. Account for any uncommitted work separately from committed evidence. Check each required outcome against real code, real fixtures, build.zig steps, manifest/worklog state, and actual command results. Do not claim completion from plan text alone.

Run the relevant verification commands needed for the audit. At minimum, verify formatting/diff cleanliness where applicable, corpus verification, existing tests, and any branch gate commands or documented mappings that currently exist. If a named branch gate is missing, record it as a gap unless WORKLOG.md maps it to an equivalent existing command with coverage.

Report:
- selected active plan and why it wins over nearby docs
- current git state, including uncommitted files
- phase-by-phase status: DONE, PARTIAL, NOT DONE, or BLOCKED
- concrete evidence for every DONE item
- remaining gaps ordered by importance
- exact next implementation step

Do not mark the branch complete unless every definition-of-done item has concrete evidence from code, manifests, tests, and command output.
